pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 ORDER OF ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we use words to create vivid pictures of a person or place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify various types of adjectives in texts
2. use the correct order of adjectives in oral and written texts
3. appreciate the role of order of adjectives in communication for clarity

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives

Teach
• Focus skill: identify various types of adjectives in texts.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we use words to create vivid pictures of a person or place?
2. Why is it important to order adjectives correctly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
